credits.note: No transfer or restoration engineer is identified. An uploader account is present but is not expanded into an engineering credit.

date.note: The Archive item was uploaded in May 2020 and Commons in January 2021; neither is established as the transfer date.

processing.value: Both sides of a 45-rpm EP combined; WAV source converted to FLAC and MP3 access derivatives.
processing.note: The Archive file manifest traces the FLAC to the WAV and its SHA-1 matches the Commons source. The side-join location, equalisation, speed correction and noise processing are not documented.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative supplied by Wikimedia Commons; uploaded FLAC derived from the Archive WAV transfer

composition.value: Underlying composition is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms.
composition.note: Bach died in 1750. This does not clear a separately protected modern performing edition.
